pages.title: Electricity Rates by ZIP Code in California (2026)
pages.note: No per-ZIP table (no primary source publishes one). Teaches the lookup (CPUC Rate Comparison by ZIP/city/county, CEC service-area map updated Aug 5 2026, CalCCA map, OpenEI URDB), CCA step (CPUC lists 12/12/2 CCAs in PG&E/SCE/SDG&E areas), standard-plan prices for PG&E/SCE/SDG&E/SMUD/LADWP, baseline territory/climate zone examples, PAO averages and SMUD 750 kWh bill comparison, EIA 2025/June 2026 state prices.

pages.title: PG&E Rate Schedules 2026: Every Residential Tariff

content_fixes.fact: CPUC Climate Credit page (https://www.cpuc.ca.gov/climatecredit, checked 2026-09-23): each amount is paid in August and again in September: PG&E $36.18, SCE $36.00, SDG&E $49.36 each month.
